verdict.rationale: Check documents a benefits object that captures benefit types, dates, and employee and company contributions, and its marketing site lists 401k among its features. That suggests retirement contributions can be tracked per employee within payroll. However, nothing in the evidence shows contributions syncing automatically with a 401(k) provider or recordkeeper on each payroll run. Missing for 10: documented automatic per-payroll sync of contributions with a retirement plan provider, details on 401(k)-specific plan setup and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
